replies.author: Ironsoldier2000
replies.body:
Hello,

Please do not make so many individual topics about your appeal, it has been denied. Your first few questions are not really important and do not pertain to the topic you are discussing. We do have the recording; however, the whole video is not required as it does not really show anything. Finally, you do not need to be screenshared. Unless it is a DIRE situation you are not bound to screen-sharing as it is a precautionary measure used in the event that we cannot come to a conclusion about a player's validity.

Cheers,
Iron

(I will leave this thread open for INTELLECTUAL and WELL THOUGHT OUT points/questions.)

In the video you were using anti-knockback, that was clear to see, and I don't think a screenshare was needed due to the circumstances. We have determined the replay mod accurate and I don't see a way your hits or kb could've been legit. 

Formulate a decent case and good points to oppose your ban instead of complaining about it and maybe you'll be appealed. 

Iron leaving the discussion open was a nice gesture, take advantage of it.

Regards,
